Context: 6. Petitions to President

3. Contents.(i) Should be complete in all respects duly supported by copy of the order complained against as well as copies of orders, if any, passed by subordinate authorities; (ii) to contain all material statements and arguments relied upon; (iii) should not contain any disloyal, disrespectful or improper language, and (iv) if it is Review Petition under CCS (CCA) Rules, it should mention how the Revision Petition was disposed of. The petition should finally end with a specific prayer.
